desc: Elevate your hearing protection with the ULTRX Shield Slim Fit Passive Muff. Designed for adults, these earmuffs combine a comfortable, razor slim profile with exceptional features. These earmuffs feature an adjustable headband and cushioned ear cups, ensuring a snug yet gentle fit providing superior comfort for prolonged use. The folding design ensures easy storage and portability solutions. Crafted with a durable rubberized exterior, these earmuffs are built to withstand your daily activities while providing reliable hearing protection. Whether you're headed to the range, the workshop, or construction zone, these earmuffs have you covered. Experience top-tier comfort and unparalleled hearing protection with ULTRX where comfort, convenience, and durability unite!
